comment: Shared accept/reject cases for transaction amount (parseAmount). Both Next (src/lib/transactiondraft.test.ts) and Go (faas/internal/transactiondraft) load this file. Reject errors are byte-identical across backends. Accept returns stored (normalized to exactly 2 fractional digits).
invalidAmountError: Invalid amount: non-zero decimal string, optional leading minus (no plus), at most 2 fractional digits, absolute value at most 999999999999.99, no spaces; e.g. 10, 10.5, 10.50, -1.5
